ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Transfers a resource to a different resource group

ConvertPostPayOrder.description_en: Converts a pay-as-you-go instance to a subscription instance
ConvertPostPayOrder.description_zh: 将后付费实例转为预付费实例

CreateConsumerGroup.description_en: Calls CreateConsumerGroup to create a consumer group

CreatePostPayInstance.description_en: Creates a pay-as-you-go instance and returns the instance ID and order ID
CreatePostPayInstance.description_zh: 创建后付费实例并返回实例ID和订单ID

CreatePostPayOrder.description_en: Pay-as-you-go instances are billed based on the actual usage of purchased resource specifications. You use resources first and then pay for them. This billing method is suitable for testing or short-term scenarios with unpredictable traffic peaks. This topic describes how to call CreatePostPayOrder to create a pay-as-you-go instance
CreatePostPayOrder.description_zh: 后付费实例根据所购资源规格的实际使用量计费，先使用，后计费。主要适用于测试或者流量峰值不确定的短期场景。本文介绍如何调用CreatePostPayOrder创建后付费实例

CreatePrePayInstance.description_en: Creates a subscription instance and returns the instance ID and order ID
CreatePrePayInstance.description_zh: 创建预付费实例并返回实例ID和订单ID

CreatePrePayOrder.description_en: Creates a subscription instance. Subscription instances require upfront payment before you can use resources. This billing method is suitable for long-term stable business scenarios
CreatePrePayOrder.description_zh: 预付费实例需要先付费才能使用资源，主要适用于长期稳定的业务运行场景。本文介绍调用CreatePrePayOrder创建预付费实例

CreateSaslUser.description_en: Creates a Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL) user by calling CreateSaslUser

CreateScheduledScalingRule.description_en: Creates a scheduled elastic scaling policy for a serverless instance after deployment
CreateScheduledScalingRule.description_zh: Serverless 系列实例部署后，允许通过该接口创建实例弹性定时策略配置

DeleteInstance.description_en: Deletes an instance after a subscription or pay-as-you-go instance is released. This topic describes how to call the DeleteInstance operation to delete an instance
DeleteInstance.description_zh: 当预付费实例或后付费实例被释放后可删除实例，本文介绍如何调用DeleteInstance删除实例

DeleteSaslUser.description_en: You can call the DeleteSaslUser operation to delete a Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL) user

DeleteScheduledScalingRule.description_en: After a Serverless instance is deployed, you can call this API operation to delete its scheduled scaling policy configuration
DeleteScheduledScalingRule.description_zh: Serverless 系列实例部署后，允许通过该接口删除实例弹性定时策略配置

DescribeSaslUsers.description_en: You can call DescribeSaslUsers to query SASL users

EnableAutoGroupCreation.description_en: Enables or disables the free use of groups by calling EnableAutoGroupCreation
EnableAutoGroupCreation.description_zh: 本文介绍如何调用EnableAutoGroupCreation开启和关闭自由使用Group

EnableAutoTopicCreation.description_en: This topic describes how to call the EnableAutoTopicCreation operation to enable or disable automatic topic creation and modify the default number of partitions for automatically created topics
EnableAutoTopicCreation.description_zh: 本文介绍如何调用 EnableAutoTopicCreation 开启和关闭自动创建Topic，以及修改自动创建 Topic 默认分区数

GetAllInstanceIdList.description_en: Queries the IDs of all instances in the current account
GetAllInstanceIdList.description_zh: 查询当前用户下所有实例ID集合

GetAllowedIpList.description_en: The GetAllowedIpList operation retrieves the IP address allowlist

GetAutoScalingConfiguration.description_en: After a Serverless instance is deployed, you can call this API operation to query the auto scaling configuration of the instance
GetAutoScalingConfiguration.description_zh: Serverless 系列实例部署后，允许通过该接口查询实例弹性定时策略配置

GetConsumerList.description_en: Retrieves a list of consumer groups

GetConsumerProgress.description_en: Queries the consumption status of a consumer group

GetInstanceList.description_en: Queries information about instances in a specified region
GetInstanceList.description_zh: 查询指定地域的实例信息

GetKafkaClientIp.description_en: Retrieves the IP addresses of Kafka clients

GetQuotaTip.description_en: Retrieves the usage quotas for topics and partitions
GetQuotaTip.description_zh: 获取Topic和分区的使用配额

GetRiskList.description_en: Queries the list of threats on an instance

GetTopicStatus.description_en: Retrieves the message sending and receiving status of a topic

GetTopicSubscribeStatus.description_en: Retrieves the subscription status of Groups for a topic
GetTopicSubscribeStatus.description_zh: 获取订阅 Topic 的 Group 信息

ListRebalanceInfo.description_en: Queries the details of rebalancing tasks

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the list of tags that are attached to resources
ListTagResources.description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询资源绑定的标签列表

ModifyInstanceName.description_en: You can modify the name of an ApsaraMQ for Kafka instance after it is deployed. This topic describes how to call the ModifyInstanceName operation
ModifyInstanceName.description_zh: 实例部署完成后，云消息队列 Kafka 版支持修改实例的名称。本文介绍如何调用ModifyInstanceName修改实例的名称

ModifyPartitionNum.description_en: This operation modifies the number of partitions in a topic

ModifyScheduledScalingRule.description_en: After you deploy Serverless instances, you can call this API operation to modify their scheduled scaling policy
ModifyScheduledScalingRule.description_zh: Serverless 系列实例部署后，允许通过该接口修改实例弹性定时策略

ModifyTopicRemark.description_en: Modifies the remark of a topic

QueryMessage.description_en: Queries messages stored in a topic by message creation time or offset
QueryMessage.description_zh: 查询 Topic 中存储的消息，可通过消息创建时间或者位点来进行查询

StartInstance.description_en: You must purchase and deploy an ApsaraMQ for Kafka instance before you can send and receive messages. This topic describes how to deploy an instance by calling the StartInstance operation
StartInstance.description_zh: 如需使用云消息队列 Kafka 版收发消息，需要购买并部署才可使用，本文介绍如何调用StartInstance部署实例

TagResources.description_en: You can call the TagResources operation to attach tags to resources

UntagResources.description_en: You can call UntagResources to detach tags from resources

UpdateAllowedIp.description_en: You can call the UpdateAllowedIp operation to edit the IP whitelist for an ApsaraMQ for Kafka instance. The whitelist specifies the IP addresses and ports that are allowed to access the instance
UpdateAllowedIp.description_zh: 您可以编辑访问云消息队列 Kafka 版的白名单，配置在白名单中的IP地址与端口才允许访问云消息队列 Kafka 版实例，本文介绍如何调用UpdateAllowedIp变更IP白名单

UpdateConsumerOffset.description_en: The UpdateConsumerOffset operation resets the consumer offset of a consumer group
UpdateConsumerOffset.description_zh: 通过 UpdateConsumerOffset 重置消费者组的消费位点

UpdateInstanceConfig.description_en: After an instance is deployed, you can modify configurations such as enabling Access Control List (ACL) and SSL, the message retention period, and the maximum message size. This topic describes how to call the UpdateInstanceConfig operation to modify the configuration of an instance
UpdateInstanceConfig.description_zh: 实例部署后，允许修改实例是否开启ACL、SSL、消息保留时长及最大消息大小，本文介绍如何调用UpdateInstanceConfig修改实例配置

UpdateTopicConfig.description_en: After a topic is created, you can modify its configurations, such as the message retention period and maximum message size. This topic describes how to call this API operation to modify topic configurations
UpdateTopicConfig.description_zh: Topic创建后，允许修改 Topic 的消息保留时长以及最大消息大小等配置，本文介绍如何调用接口来修改 Topic 的配置

UpgradeInstanceVersion.description_en: Upgrades the version of an instance
